note: Corps of Engineers campground on the White River arm of Table Rock Lake, about 8 miles from Branson, beside the Indian Point marina, with a swim beach and boat ramp. The sites are wooded; several look out over the marina and the lake. --Claude
summary: rec.gov read: 74 sites (70 RV, 12-60 ft, 11 pull-through), 50A+water / 30A, no sewer, $16-25, Apr 1-Oct 30, 14 nights. Waterfront downgraded lakefront -> lakeview (marina lot / road / wooded bank between every site and the water). Pin is the facility point; phone added.
flags: WATERFRONT CHANGE: lakefront -> lakeview. Each of the three loops was checked against the 50 m open-apron rule. Sites 1-28 sit on the point inside the marina loop road. The paved marina and boat-ramp parking lot runs along their west and south sides, and the road plus a wooded strip about 50-70 m wide runs along the north. Sites 48-57 are on a wooded slope above the swim-beach cove. Sites 53, 54 and 57 are about 30-40 m from the riprap shore, but through continuous trees and down a bank. Sites 58-74 are on a wooded ridge more than 100 m from either arm, with the marina lot to the west. No site has an open, unused apron to the water. The recreation.gov photos of 08, 09, 12, 22 and 24 show the lake and the marina over the lot and through the trees, which earns lakeview. The old note's 'many lakefront sites' is dropped.

PIN (move): the stored 36.6311,-93.3472 is recreation.gov's facility point. It sits in the woods north of the 48-57 loop, about 170 m from the nearest site and 280 m from the centroid of the 74 sites. That centroid, 36.62857,-93.34726, falls on the marina docks between the loops. Proposed pin: 36.62941,-93.34628, which is site 52 on the middle loop, between the 1-28 point and the 58-74 ridge.

FIT: a 23-ft rig fits most sites. The ones that don't: 31 and 41 (12 ft), 45 (18 ft), 53 and 54 (20 ft, the non-electric pull-throughs), and 26 (25 ft, tight). The A01-A08 records aren't reservable and have no length; they're likely staff or host pads and aren't counted.

SEASON: written as 04-01 to 10-30, the 2027 dates. The stored season was year_round false, derived; it's now manual with dates. booking.min_stay isn't set: the 3-night minimum applies to holiday weekends only.
NOTE: the old note's '74 sites, mostly electric+water' and 'reservable online Apr-Oct' are now carried by sites, hookups, booking and season. The rewrite drops them and keeps the setting.
